entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • RDG emits invalid code when endpoint handler return type is an IErrorTypeSymbol (cross-generator scenario) #65452
  • Identity: IdentityUserContext does not use the virtual Property SchemaVersion which results in pending changes is no service provider is set #65449

Closed

  • Request Browser-Testing Dependencies Update #65286
  • Custom validations are having strange behaviour on invalid input #65450
  • dotnet dev-certs https --trust failing in on GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner in SDK Version 10.0.103 #65391
    10.0.4

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix race in RST_STREAM_IncompleteRequest HTTP/2 tests #65454
    area-networking
  • Fix RDG generating invalid code for types from other source generators #65453
    area-networking
  • QuickGrid SSR support #65451
    area-blazor

Merged

  • Securely overwrite X-Content-Length for mitigating request smuggling via TransferEncoding & ContentLength headers #65445
    area-networking, 11.0-preview2
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #65448
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 11.0-preview2
  • Update browser testing dependencies: Selenium 4.40.0, Playwright 1.57.0 #65304
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview2
  • Make report-green.yml run on agentless server job #65444
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview2

    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal

    area-minimal, feature-validation

    area-blazor
